void emit(string text)
    println(text)

bool includes_text(string[] items, string value)
    for item := items[]
        if item == value
            return true
    return false

int index_of(string[] items, string value)
    for: i < #items
        if items[i] == value
            return int(i)
    return -1

bool digits(string text)
    if text == ""
        return false
    for: i < #text
        if not "0123456789".contains(text[i])
            return false
    return true

int greatest_divisor(int a, int b)
    while b != 0
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

class Fraction(numerator := 0, denominator := 1)
    Fraction normalized()
        p := numerator
        q := denominator
        if q < 0
            p = -p
            q = -q
        divisor := greatest_divisor(if p < 0 then -p else p, q)
        return Fraction(p / divisor, q / divisor)

    Fraction plus(Fraction other)
        return Fraction(numerator * other.denominator + other.numerator * denominator, denominator * other.denominator).normalized()

    Fraction minus(Fraction other)
        return Fraction(numerator * other.denominator - other.numerator * denominator, denominator * other.denominator).normalized()

    Fraction times(Fraction other)
        return Fraction(numerator * other.numerator, denominator * other.denominator).normalized()

    Fraction over(Fraction other)
        return Fraction(numerator * other.denominator, denominator * other.numerator).normalized()

    Fraction negative()
        return Fraction(-numerator, denominator)

    bool is_zero()
        return numerator == 0

    bool less_than(Fraction other)
        return numerator * other.denominator < other.numerator * denominator

    string fraction_text()
        return if denominator == 1 then string(numerator) else "{numerator}/{denominator}"

    string value_text()
        magnitude := if numerator < 0 then -numerator else numerator
        scaled := magnitude * 1000000 / denominator
        tail := string(scaled % 1000000)
        string decimal := (if numerator < 0 then "-" else "") + "{scaled / 1000000}." + "0" * (6 - #tail) + tail
        return fraction_text() + " (" + decimal + ")"

Fraction | error parse_value(string original)
    text := original
    multiplier := Fraction(1)
    if text.ends_with("meg")
        multiplier = Fraction(1000000)
        text = text[:<#text - 3]
    elif text.ends_with("k")
        multiplier = Fraction(1000)
        text = text[:<#text - 1]
    elif text.ends_with("m")
        multiplier = Fraction(1, 1000)
        text = text[:<#text - 1]
    elif text.ends_with("u")
        multiplier = Fraction(1, 1000000)
        text = text[:<#text - 1]
    negative := text.starts_with("-")
    if negative
        text = text[1:]
    value := Fraction()
    valid := false
    if digits(text)
        value = Fraction(int(text))
        valid = true
    else
        parts := text.split(".")
        if #parts == 2 and digits(parts[0]) and digits(parts[1])
            scale := 1
            for: i < #parts[1]
                scale *= 10
            value = Fraction(int(parts[0]) * scale + int(parts[1]), scale).normalized()
            valid = true
        else
            parts = text.split("/")
            if #parts == 2 and digits(parts[0]) and digits(parts[1])
                bottom := int(parts[1])
                if bottom != 0
                    value = Fraction(int(parts[0]), bottom).normalized()
                    valid = true
    if not valid
        return error("invalid value " + original)
    value = value.times(multiplier)
    return if negative then value.negative() else value

bool valid_node(string text)
    if text == "0"
        return true
    if #text == 0 or #text > 8 or not "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(text[0])
        return false
    for: i < #text
        if not "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789".contains(text[i])
            return false
    return true

class Element(string name, string n1, string n2, Fraction value, c1 := "", c2 := "", vname := "")
class Link(string a, string b)
class Edge(string a, string b, Fraction conductance)
class Resistor(string name, string a, string b, Fraction resistance)
class ColumnEntry(string key, Fraction value)

string[] terminals(Element item)
    return if item.c1 == "" then [item.n1, item.n2] else [item.n1, item.n2, item.c1, item.c2]

string[] all_nodes(Element[] items, ground := false)
    string[] result := []
    for item := items[]
        for node := terminals(item)[]
            if (ground or node != "0") and not includes_text(result, node)
                result = result.append(node)
    return result.sorted()

string[] reachable(string start, Link[] links)
    result := [start]
    nat cursor := 0
    while cursor < #result
        current := result[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        for item := links[]
            if item.a == current and not includes_text(result, item.b)
                result = result.append(item.b)
            if item.b == current and not includes_text(result, item.a)
                result = result.append(item.a)
    return result

string[] floating_nodes(Element[] items)
    Link[] links := []
    for item := items[]
        if includes_text(["R", "V", "E", "H"], item.name[0])
            links = links.append(Link(item.n1, item.n2))
    grounded := reachable("0", links)
    return [for node := all_nodes(items)[] if not includes_text(grounded, node) then node]

string[] voltage_loops(Element[] items)
    string[] result := []
    Link[] links := []
    for item := items[]
        if includes_text(["V", "E", "H"], item.name[0])
            if includes_text(reachable(item.n1, links), item.n2)
                result = result.append(item.name)
            links = links.append(Link(item.n1, item.n2))
    return result

void | error check_structure(Element[] items)
    if #all_nodes(items) == 0
        return error("no nodes")
    floating := floating_nodes(items)
    if #floating > 0
        return error("floating node " + floating[0])
    loops := voltage_loops(items)
    if #loops > 0
        return error("voltage source loop at " + loops[0])
    return void

Fraction[][] zero_matrix(nat size)
    return [for i := (0:<nat(size))[] then [for j := (0:<nat(size))[] then Fraction()]]

void add_matrix(Fraction[][] &rows, string[] keys, string row, string column, Fraction value)
    r := index_of(keys, row)
    c := index_of(keys, column)
    if r >= 0 and c >= 0
        rows[r][c] = rows[r][c].plus(value)

void add_column(Fraction[] &values, string[] keys, string key, Fraction value)
    index := index_of(keys, key)
    if index >= 0
        values[index] = values[index].plus(value)

Fraction[] | none gauss_jordan(Fraction[][] matrix, Fraction[] column)
    size := #matrix
    rows := [for i := (0:<nat(size))[] then matrix[i].append(column[i])]
    for: k < size
        pivot := -1
        for: k <= r < size
            if not rows[r][k].is_zero()
                pivot = int(r)
                break
        if pivot < 0
            return none
        previous := rows[k]
        rows[k] = rows[pivot]
        rows[pivot] = previous
        divisor := rows[k][k]
        for: j <= size
            rows[k][j] = rows[k][j].over(divisor)
        for: i < size
            factor := rows[i][k]
            if i != k and not factor.is_zero()
                for: j <= size
                    rows[i][j] = rows[i][j].minus(factor.times(rows[k][j]))
    return [for i := (0:<nat(size))[] then rows[i][size]]

ColumnEntry[] source_entries(Element item, Fraction value)
    return if item.name[0] == "I" then [ColumnEntry(item.n1, value.negative()), ColumnEntry(item.n2, value)] else [ColumnEntry(item.name, value)]

class Solution(string[] keys, Fraction[] values)
    Fraction voltage(string node)
        return if node == "0" then Fraction() else values[index_of(keys, node)]

    Fraction current(string name)
        return values[index_of(keys, name)]

    Fraction difference(string a, string b)
        return voltage(a).minus(voltage(b))

    Fraction element_current(Element item)
        kind := item.name[0]
        if kind == "R"
            return difference(item.n1, item.n2).over(item.value)
        if kind == "I"
            return item.value
        if kind == "G"
            return item.value.times(difference(item.c1, item.c2))
        if kind == "F"
            return item.value.times(current(item.vname))
        return current(item.name)

class Equations(Element[] netlist)
    nodes := all_nodes(netlist)
    Element[] voltage_sources := [for item := netlist[] if includes_text(["V", "E", "H"], item.name[0]) then item]
    string[] unknowns := nodes.concat([for item := voltage_sources[] then item.name])
    matrix := zero_matrix(#unknowns)
    Fraction[] rhs := [for i := (nat(0):<#unknowns)[] then Fraction()]

    void .build()
        one := Fraction(1)
        for item := netlist[]
            kind := item.name[0]
            if kind == "R"
                g := one.over(item.value)
                add_matrix(&matrix, unknowns, item.n1, item.n1, g)
                add_matrix(&matrix, unknowns, item.n2, item.n2, g)
                add_matrix(&matrix, unknowns, item.n1, item.n2, g.negative())
                add_matrix(&matrix, unknowns, item.n2, item.n1, g.negative())
            elif kind == "G"
                add_matrix(&matrix, unknowns, item.n1, item.c1, item.value)
                add_matrix(&matrix, unknowns, item.n2, item.c2, item.value)
                add_matrix(&matrix, unknowns, item.n1, item.c2, item.value.negative())
                add_matrix(&matrix, unknowns, item.n2, item.c1, item.value.negative())
            elif kind == "F"
                add_matrix(&matrix, unknowns, item.n1, item.vname, item.value)
                add_matrix(&matrix, unknowns, item.n2, item.vname, item.value.negative())
            elif kind == "V" or kind == "E" or kind == "H"
                add_matrix(&matrix, unknowns, item.n1, item.name, one)
                add_matrix(&matrix, unknowns, item.name, item.n1, one)
                add_matrix(&matrix, unknowns, item.n2, item.name, one.negative())
                add_matrix(&matrix, unknowns, item.name, item.n2, one.negative())
                if kind == "E"
                    add_matrix(&matrix, unknowns, item.name, item.c1, item.value.negative())
                    add_matrix(&matrix, unknowns, item.name, item.c2, item.value)
                elif kind == "H"
                    add_matrix(&matrix, unknowns, item.name, item.vname, item.value.negative())
            if kind == "V" or kind == "I"
                for entry := source_entries(item, item.value)[]
                    add_column(&rhs, unknowns, entry.key, entry.value)

    Fraction[] column(ColumnEntry[] entries)
        result := [for i := (nat(0):<#unknowns)[] then Fraction()]
        for entry := entries[]
            add_column(&result, unknowns, entry.key, entry.value)
        return result

    Solution | error solve(Fraction[] values)
        match gauss_jordan(matrix, values)
            Fraction[] result
                return Solution(unknowns, result)
            none
                return error("singular matrix")

    Solution | error injection(string a, string b)
        return solve(column([ColumnEntry(a, Fraction(1)), ColumnEntry(b, Fraction(-1))]))

    Solution | error source_alone(Element item, Fraction value)
        return solve(column(source_entries(item, value)))

class Operating(Equations equations, Solution solution)

ColumnEntry[] sensitivity_entries(Element item, Solution operating)
    kind := item.name[0]
    one := Fraction(1)
    if kind == "R"
        value := operating.element_current(item).over(item.value)
        return [ColumnEntry(item.n1, value), ColumnEntry(item.n2, value.negative())]
    if kind == "I"
        return [ColumnEntry(item.n1, one.negative()), ColumnEntry(item.n2, one)]
    if kind == "G" or kind == "F"
        value := if kind == "G" then operating.difference(item.c1, item.c2) else operating.current(item.vname)
        return [ColumnEntry(item.n1, value.negative()), ColumnEntry(item.n2, value)]
    value := if kind == "V" then one else (if kind == "E" then operating.difference(item.c1, item.c2) else operating.current(item.vname))
    return [ColumnEntry(item.name, value)]

class Circuit()
    Element[] elements := []

    int find_element(string name)
        for: i < #elements
            if elements[i].name == name
                return int(i)
        return -1

    nat | error check_element(string name)
        int index := find_element(name)
        if index < 0
            return error("unknown element " + name)
        return nat(index)

    void | error check_node(string node)
        if node != "0" and not includes_text(all_nodes(elements), node)
            return error("unknown node " + node)
        return void

    Operating | error operating_point()
        try check_structure(elements)
        equations := Equations(elements)
        .equations.build()
        solution := try equations.solve(equations.rhs)
        return Operating(equations, solution)

    void | error .add_element(string[] words)
        name := words[0]
        kind := name[0]
        if not includes_text(["R", "V", "I", "E", "G", "F", "H"], kind)
            return error("unknown element type " + name)
        nat count := if kind == "E" or kind == "G" then 6 else (if kind == "F" or kind == "H" then 5 else 4)
        if #words != count
            return error("wrong field count for " + name)
        if find_element(name) >= 0
            return error("duplicate element " + name)
        nat node_count := if kind == "E" or kind == "G" then 4 else 2
        for: 1 <= i <= node_count
            if not valid_node(words[i])
                return error("invalid node " + words[i])
        vname := ""
        if kind == "F" or kind == "H"
            vname = words[3]
            int source := find_element(vname)
            if source < 0 or elements[source].name[0] != "V"
                return error("unknown voltage source " + vname)
        value := try parse_value(words[-1])
        if kind == "R" and value.numerator <= 0
            return error("nonpositive resistance " + name)
        c1 := if node_count == 4 then words[3] else ""
        c2 := if node_count == 4 then words[4] else ""
        elements = elements.append(Element(name, words[1], words[2], value, c1, c2, vname))
        return void

    string[] | error req_equivalent(string a, string b)
        Link[] wires := []
        for item := elements[]
            if item.name[0] == "V"
                wires = wires.append(Link(item.n1, item.n2))
        map<string, string> groups
        for node := ["0"].concat(all_nodes(elements))[]
            match groups.get(node)
                string existing
                    continue
                none
                    for member := reachable(node, wires)[]
                        .groups.set(member, node)
        group_a := ""
        group_b := ""
        match groups.get(a)
            string name
                group_a = name
            none
                void
        match groups.get(b)
            string name
                group_b = name
            none
                void
        if group_a == group_b
            return ["Req = 0 (0.000000)"]
        Edge[] edges := []
        Link[] links := []
        for item := elements[]
            if item.name[0] != "R"
                continue
            p := ""
            q := ""
            match groups.get(item.n1)
                string name
                    p = name
                none
                    void
            match groups.get(item.n2)
                string name
                    q = name
                none
                    void
            if p != q
                edges = edges.append(Edge(p, q, Fraction(1).over(item.value)))
                links = links.append(Link(p, q))
        reached := reachable(group_a, links)
        if not includes_text(reached, group_b)
            return ["Req = INFINITE"]
        keys := [for node := reached.sorted()[] if node != group_b then node]
        matrix := zero_matrix(#keys)
        for edge := edges[]
            if includes_text(reached, edge.a)
                add_matrix(&matrix, keys, edge.a, edge.a, edge.conductance)
                add_matrix(&matrix, keys, edge.b, edge.b, edge.conductance)
                add_matrix(&matrix, keys, edge.a, edge.b, edge.conductance.negative())
                add_matrix(&matrix, keys, edge.b, edge.a, edge.conductance.negative())
        column := [for i := (nat(0):<#keys)[] then Fraction()]
        column[index_of(keys, group_a)] = Fraction(1)
        match gauss_jordan(matrix, column)
            Fraction[] values
                return ["Req = " + values[index_of(keys, group_a)].value_text()]
            none
                return error("singular matrix")

    string[] reduce_network(string a, string b)
        if a == b
            return ["Req = 0 (0.000000)"]
        Resistor[] items := []
        Link[] links := []
        for item := elements[]
            if item.name[0] == "R"
                items = items.append(Resistor(item.name, item.n1, item.n2, item.value))
                links = links.append(Link(item.n1, item.n2))
        connected := reachable(a, links)
        if not includes_text(connected, b)
            return ["Req = INFINITE"]
        items = [for item := items[] if includes_text(connected, item.a) then item]
        string[] output := []
        nat serial := 0
        while true
            removal := -1
            for: i < #items
                if items[i].a == items[i].b
                    removal = int(i)
                    break
            if removal >= 0
                output = output.append("remove " + items[removal].name)
                items = items[:<nat(removal)].concat(items[nat(removal) + 1:])
                continue
            map<string, nat> degrees
            for item := items[]
                for node := [item.a, item.b][]
                    nat count := 0
                    match degrees.get(node)
                        nat value
                            count = value
                        none
                            void
                    .degrees.set(node, count + 1)
            internal_nodes := [for node := degrees.keys().sorted()[] if node != a and node != b then node]
            for node := internal_nodes[]
                nat degree := 0
                match degrees.get(node)
                    nat value
                        degree = value
                    none
                        void
                if degree == 1
                    for: i < #items
                        if items[i].a == node or items[i].b == node
                            removal = int(i)
                            break
                    break
            if removal >= 0
                output = output.append("remove " + items[removal].name)
                items = items[:<nat(removal)].concat(items[nat(removal) + 1:])
                continue
            first := -1
            second := -1
            end_a := ""
            end_b := ""
            operation := "||"
            resistance := Fraction()
            for: i < #items
                for: i + 1 <= j < #items
                    same := (items[i].a == items[j].a and items[i].b == items[j].b) or (items[i].a == items[j].b and items[i].b == items[j].a)
                    if same
                        first = int(i)
                        second = int(j)
                        break
                if first >= 0
                    break
            if first >= 0
                end_a = items[first].a
                end_b = items[first].b
                resistance = items[first].resistance.times(items[second].resistance).over(items[first].resistance.plus(items[second].resistance))
            else
                operation = "+"
                for node := internal_nodes[]
                    nat degree := 0
                    match degrees.get(node)
                        nat value
                            degree = value
                        none
                            void
                    if degree != 2
                        continue
                    nat[] touching := []
                    for: i < #items
                        if items[i].a == node or items[i].b == node
                            touching = touching.append(i)
                    first = int(touching[0])
                    second = int(touching[1])
                    end_a = if items[first].a == node then items[first].b else items[first].a
                    end_b = if items[second].a == node then items[second].b else items[second].a
                    resistance = items[first].resistance.plus(items[second].resistance)
                    break
            if first < 0
                break
            serial += 1
            name := "#{serial}"
            output = output.append(name + " = " + items[first].name + " " + operation + " " + items[second].name + " = " + resistance.value_text())
            Resistor[] kept := []
            for: i < #items
                if int(i) != first and int(i) != second
                    kept = kept.append(items[i])
            items = kept.append(Resistor(name, end_a, end_b, resistance))
        if #items == 1
            output = output.append("Req = " + items[0].resistance.value_text())
        else
            output = output.append("not series-parallel: {#items} resistors remain")
        return output

    string[] check_circuit()
        nodes := all_nodes(elements)
        if #nodes == 0
            return ["no nodes"]
        string[] output := []
        for node := nodes[]
            nat degree := 0
            for item := elements[]
                if item.n1 == node
                    degree += 1
                if item.n2 == node
                    degree += 1
            if degree < 2
                output = output.append("dangling node " + node)
        for node := floating_nodes(elements)[]
            output = output.append("floating node " + node)
        for name := voltage_loops(elements)[]
            output = output.append("voltage source loop at " + name)
        if #output == 0
            equations := Equations(elements)
            .equations.build()
            match equations.solve(equations.rhs)
                Solution solution
                    void
                error failure
                    output = output.append("singular matrix")
        return if #output == 0 then ["ok"] else output

    string[] | error .run_command(string[] words)
        commands := [".OP", ".CURRENT", ".VOLTAGE", ".POWER", ".KCL", ".THEVENIN", ".NORTON", ".MAXPOWER", ".TF", ".SENS", ".ZPARAM", ".SUPERPOSITION", ".SWEEP", ".MATRIX", ".REQ", ".REDUCE", ".CHECK", ".ALTER", ".DELETE", ".CLEAR", ".NODES", ".PRINT"]
        nat[] counts := [0, 1, 2, 0, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 4, 1, 5, 0, 2, 2, 0, 2, 1, 0, 0, 0]
        command := words[0]
        command_index := index_of(commands, command)
        if command_index < 0
            return error("unknown command " + command)
        if #words != counts[command_index] + 1
            return error("wrong argument count for " + command)
        args := words[1:]
        if command == ".ALTER"
            nat index := try check_element(args[0])
            value := try parse_value(args[1])
            if elements[index].name[0] == "R" and value.numerator <= 0
                return error("nonpositive resistance " + args[0])
            line := "altered " + args[0] + ": " + elements[index].value.fraction_text() + " -> " + value.fraction_text()
            elements[index].value = value
            return [line]
        if command == ".DELETE"
            nat index := try check_element(args[0])
            for item := elements[]
                if item.vname == args[0]
                    return error(args[0] + " is referenced by " + item.name)
            elements = elements[:<index].concat(elements[index + 1:])
            return ["deleted " + args[0]]
        if command == ".CLEAR"
            count := #elements
            elements = []
            return ["cleared {count} elements"]
        if command == ".NODES"
            if #elements == 0
                return ["no nodes"]
            string[] output := []
            for node := all_nodes(elements, true)[]
                names := [for item := elements[] if includes_text(terminals(item), node) then item.name]
                output = output.append(node + ": " + names.join(" "))
            return output
        if command == ".PRINT"
            string[] output := []
            for item := elements[]
                string[] fields := [item.name].concat(terminals(item))
                if item.vname != ""
                    fields = fields.append(item.vname)
                fields = fields.append(item.value.fraction_text())
                output = output.append(fields.join(" "))
            return if #output == 0 then ["empty netlist"] else output
        if command == ".CHECK"
            return check_circuit()
        if command == ".REQ" or command == ".REDUCE"
            try check_node(args[0])
            try check_node(args[1])
            return if command == ".REQ" then req_equivalent(args[0], args[1]) else reduce_network(args[0], args[1])
        if command == ".SWEEP"
            nat index := try check_element(args[0])
            first := try parse_value(args[1])
            last := try parse_value(args[2])
            step := try parse_value(args[3])
            try check_node(args[4])
            if step.numerator <= 0
                return error("invalid sweep step")
            if last.less_than(first)
                return error("invalid sweep range")
            span := last.minus(first).over(step)
            count := span.numerator / span.denominator + 1
            if count > 20
                return error("too many sweep points")
            if elements[index].name[0] == "R" and first.numerator <= 0
                return error("nonpositive resistance " + args[0])
            try check_structure(elements)
            string[] output := []
            for: k < count
                value := first.plus(step.times(Fraction(k)))
                trial := elements
                trial[index].value = value
                equations := Equations(trial)
                .equations.build()
                prefix := args[0] + " = " + value.fraction_text() + ": "
                match equations.solve(equations.rhs)
                    Solution solution
                        output = output.append(prefix + "V(" + args[4] + ") = " + solution.voltage(args[4]).value_text())
                    error failure
                        output = output.append(prefix + "singular matrix")
            return output
        if command == ".MATRIX"
            try check_structure(elements)
            equations := Equations(elements)
            .equations.build()
            string[] labels := [for node := equations.nodes[] then "V(" + node + ")"].concat([for item := equations.voltage_sources[] then "I(" + item.name + ")"])
            output := ["unknowns: " + labels.join(" ")]
            for: i < #equations.unknowns
                entries := [for value := equations.matrix[i][] then value.fraction_text()]
                output = output.append(equations.unknowns[i] + ": " + entries.join(" ") + " | " + equations.rhs[i].fraction_text())
            return output
        if command == ".CURRENT"
            try check_element(args[0])
        elif command == ".TF"
            try check_node(args[0])
            nat index := try check_element(args[1])
            if elements[index].name[0] != "V" and elements[index].name[0] != "I"
                return error("not an independent source " + args[1])
        else
            for node := args[]
                try check_node(node)
        Operating operating := try operating_point()
        equations := operating.equations
        solution := operating.solution
        string[] output := []
        if command == ".OP"
            for node := equations.nodes[]
                output = output.append("V(" + node + ") = " + solution.voltage(node).value_text())
            for item := equations.voltage_sources[]
                output = output.append("I(" + item.name + ") = " + solution.current(item.name).value_text())
        elif command == ".CURRENT"
            item := elements[find_element(args[0])]
            output = ["I(" + item.name + ") = " + solution.element_current(item).value_text()]
        elif command == ".VOLTAGE"
            output = ["V(" + args.join(",") + ") = " + solution.difference(args[0], args[1]).value_text()]
        elif command == ".POWER"
            absorbed := Fraction()
            delivered := Fraction()
            total := Fraction()
            for item := elements[]
                power := solution.difference(item.n1, item.n2).times(solution.element_current(item))
                output = output.append("P(" + item.name + ") = " + power.value_text())
                if power.numerator > 0
                    absorbed = absorbed.plus(power)
                elif power.numerator < 0
                    delivered = delivered.minus(power)
                total = total.plus(power)
            output = output.concat(["absorbed = " + absorbed.value_text(), "delivered = " + delivered.value_text(), "total = " + total.value_text()])
        elif command == ".KCL"
            total := Fraction()
            for item := elements[]
                if item.n1 != args[0] and item.n2 != args[0]
                    continue
                leaving := Fraction()
                if item.n1 != item.n2
                    leaving = solution.element_current(item)
                    if item.n2 == args[0]
                        leaving = leaving.negative()
                output = output.append("I(" + item.name + ") leaving " + args[0] + " = " + leaving.value_text())
                total = total.plus(leaving)
            output = output.append("sum = " + total.value_text())
        elif command == ".THEVENIN" or command == ".NORTON" or command == ".MAXPOWER"
            vth := solution.difference(args[0], args[1])
            injected := try equations.injection(args[0], args[1])
            rth := injected.difference(args[0], args[1])
            if command == ".THEVENIN"
                output = ["Vth = " + vth.value_text(), "Rth = " + rth.value_text()]
            elif command == ".NORTON"
                if rth.is_zero()
                    return error("zero thevenin resistance")
                output = ["In = " + vth.over(rth).value_text(), "Rn = " + rth.value_text()]
            else
                if rth.numerator <= 0
                    return error("nonpositive thevenin resistance")
                output = ["RL = " + rth.value_text(), "Pmax = " + vth.times(vth).over(Fraction(4).times(rth)).value_text()]
        elif command == ".TF"
            item := elements[find_element(args[1])]
            unit := try equations.source_alone(item, Fraction(1))
            output = ["gain = " + unit.voltage(args[0]).value_text()]
            if item.name[0] == "V"
                current := unit.current(item.name)
                output = output.append(if current.is_zero() then "input resistance = INFINITE" else "input resistance = " + Fraction(-1).over(current).value_text())
            else
                output = output.append("input resistance = " + unit.difference(item.n2, item.n1).value_text())
            injected := try equations.injection(args[0], "0")
            output = output.append("output resistance = " + injected.voltage(args[0]).value_text())
        elif command == ".SENS"
            for item := elements[]
                derivative := try equations.solve(equations.column(sensitivity_entries(item, solution)))
                output = output.append("dV(" + args[0] + ")/d" + item.name + " = " + derivative.voltage(args[0]).value_text())
        elif command == ".ZPARAM"
            first := try equations.injection(args[0], args[1])
            second := try equations.injection(args[2], args[3])
            output = ["z11 = " + first.difference(args[0], args[1]).value_text(), "z12 = " + second.difference(args[0], args[1]).value_text(), "z21 = " + first.difference(args[2], args[3]).value_text(), "z22 = " + second.difference(args[2], args[3]).value_text()]
        elif command == ".SUPERPOSITION"
            total := Fraction()
            for item := elements[]
                if item.name[0] == "V" or item.name[0] == "I"
                    alone := try equations.source_alone(item, item.value)
                    contribution := alone.voltage(args[0])
                    output = output.append(item.name + ": V(" + args[0] + ") = " + contribution.value_text())
                    total = total.plus(contribution)
            output = output.append("total: V(" + args[0] + ") = " + total.value_text())
        return output

void read_circuit()
    circuit := Circuit()
    line := ""
    nat number := 0
    while true
        scan(&line)
        number += 1
        if line == ".END"
            break
        if line.starts_with("*")
            continue
        words := line.split(" ")
        if line.starts_with(".")
            match .circuit.run_command(words)
                string[] output
                    for text := output[]
                        emit(text)
                error failure
                    emit("error: line {number}: " + failure.message)
        else
            match .circuit.add_element(words)
                void
                    void
                error failure
                    emit("error: line {number}: " + failure.message)

read_circuit()
